description: Selected annual public kitchen/procurement indicators. Metrics are not directly comparable unless scope/unit match.
quality_rules: Keep import_status visible in all downstream use.
Rows marked staged_needs_reconciliation_or_precision_note require table-level review before external publication.
Sector and survey rows are usable for internal analysis with source-type flags, but should not be presented as neutral official statistics.
known_gaps: Swedish rows mix public-sector value share, municipal share and KRAV-label share; metric/scope must be shown in downstream use.
Ekomatligan 2025 was checked but is an event/program page, not a statistics report.
Nordic public-kitchen metrics are not directly comparable until unit/scope are harmonized.
